home_badge: A light start without loading the whole book
home_title: YumBook opens the kitchen from the home page
home_description: Choose a category above to open only the recipes you need. A large collection starts faster, and the workspace stays calm and clear.
home_step_add_text: Create recipes manually or save useful materials as links.
home_step_category_text: Recipes load only inside the selected category, so a large book opens faster.
home_step_order_text: Drag recipes inside a category or move them to other sections.
home_step_favorites_text: Mark successful dishes as favorites so you can return to them quickly later.
home_import_text: The From link button helps save a recipe from a website, video, or note.
home_categories_title: Categories instead of one big feed
home_categories_text: The more recipes you have, the more useful it is to open them by section: soups, desserts, drinks, and your own categories.
home_fast_start_title: Home does not load the database
home_fast_start_text: On startup this page is shown first, and recipes load only when they are actually needed.
promo_german_law_buddy_description: A helper for learning German and working with useful study materials.
promo_german_law_buddy_details: An app for learning German: collect useful materials, return to them later, and gradually build your own knowledge base.
promo_daily_cue_keeper_description: A small helper for daily notes, cues, and personal reminders.
promo_daily_cue_keeper_details: A lightweight assistant for everyday tasks: notes, prompts, reminders, and short cues that help you remember what matters during the day.
promo_taste_and_trace_description: A cookbook for recipes, screenshots, links, and personal cooking notes.
promo_taste_and_trace_details: YumBook helps keep recipes organized by category, add screenshots, save materials from links, and quickly return to favorite dishes.
promo_linkora_description: A manager for links and useful materials, so important things are easy to find.
promo_linkora_details: An app for storing links, notes, and useful materials. It helps keep important pages close at hand and makes it easier to return to needed information.
promo_mixlab_description: A creative lab for experiments with media and working materials.
promo_mixlab_details: An experimental creative lab. The project can still be improved, but the idea is to make it convenient to try different media tools and workflows.
promo_linkora_v2_description: A new Linkora version with more convenient organization for links and notes.
promo_linkora_v2_details: The second version of Linkora with an updated approach to organizing links and notes. Useful when you want to keep collections, ideas, and materials neatly arranged.
promo_kalender_deutschland_description: A calendar for Germany with convenient dates, holidays, and planning.
promo_kalender_deutschland_details: A calendar for Germany: useful for viewing dates, holidays, and planning. A good fit for people who live, work, or study in Germany.
